title: 《遗忘之海》移动端 7 月 23 日首发 FAQ：iOS、Android、互通、配置与今天先看什么
titleEn: Sea of Remnants Mobile Launch FAQ: July 23 iOS/Android, Cross-Progress, Specs, and First-Day Route
summary: 面向 2026 年 7 月 23 日 10:00《遗忘之海》移动端首发的高频问题：iOS / Android 入口、PC 账号区服、配置排错、首发福利，以及 gamescom 2026 demo 带来的海外曝光信号。（历史归档：当前请先看 early 2027 / December beta 入口。）
summaryEn: A July 23, 2026 10:00 mobile-launch FAQ for Sea of Remnants covering iOS/Android access, PC account/server checks, specs, rewards, and the gamescom 2026 demo signal. Archive note: use the early-2027 / December beta route for current status.
content:
## 历史归档提示

本页保留 2026 年 7 月 PC 公测与移动端首发资料。当前遗忘之海入口已转向 early 2027 / December closed beta 观察、平台 FAQ 和下载状态；做当前判断请先看 /sea/version 或 /sea/download。

## 先给结论

截至 **2026 年 7 月 23 日 10:00**，《遗忘之海》移动端已经进入首发日。PC 端已于 **2026 年 7 月 9 日**开启公测，移动端则经历 **7 月 21 日 10:00 预下载**后正式开服。现在的重点不再是“要不要等手机端”，而是：手机端入口怎么选、账号和区服怎么统一、设备能不能稳定跑、以及今天上线后先补哪些首月资源。

今天还有一个适合放进站点的海外信号：官方/发行侧开始围绕 **gamescom 2026 可试玩 demo** 做外部曝光。它不改变国服移动端首发节奏，但会强化英文搜索里的 demo、review、gameplay、PS5/Xbox 和 Steam 相关需求。

## 今天时间线

| 节点 | 日期 | 状态 | 推荐下一步 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PC 公测 | 2026-07-09 | 已上线 | 继续看开服路线、热修和资源效率 |
| 移动端预下载 | 2026-07-21 10:00 | 已开放过预下载 | 检查安装包、剩余空间和更新完整性 |
| 移动端首发 | 2026-07-23 10:00 | 今日上线 | 先看入口、账号、配置和首日排错 |
| gamescom demo | 2026 gamescom | 官方曝光中 | 适合整理 demo / gameplay / review 相关问题 |
| 本文更新时间 | 2026-07-23 | 首发日口径 | 不再写成上线前等待页 |

## 今天先上手机还是继续 PC？

| 你的情况 | 建议 |
| --- | --- |
| 已经在 PC 开荒 | 继续 PC 推主线和资源，手机端用来补日常、收菜和碎片时间 |
| 今天才入坑 | 直接选你长期最常用的平台，先别为了短期体验频繁换端 |
| 主要是手机玩家 | 今天优先确认正式客户端、账号、区服和画质稳定性 |
| 想看画质和长时间探索 | PC 仍然更适合长线探索、截图和高负载战斗 |
| 只想先了解玩法 | 先看品类 FAQ、平台入口和首周运营总览，不急着重练账号 |

## PC 和手机互通怎么确认

站点建议继续按“三件事”确认，不把任何平台礼包默认等同：

1. **账号体系一致**：PC 和手机尽量使用同一官方账号或同一平台账号绑定路线。
2. **区服一致**：今天不要在手机端随手换服，先确认 PC 进度所在区服。
3. **奖励规则一致**：预约礼、充值、平台礼包和活动补偿都以游戏内公告为准。

## 今天玩家讨论热点

| 热点 | 推荐继续看方式 |
| --- | --- |
| iOS / Android 哪个入口是正式包 | 放到平台入口速查，避免用户找非官方包 |
| 预下载后还要不要更新 | 放到首日排错，提醒检查商店更新和空间 |
| PC 老账号怎么接手机端 | 放到互通/区服检查，不默认全平台奖励相同 |
| 首发福利、SSR、自选和抽数怎么拿 | 放到开服清单、兑换码和资源决策页，所有数量以游戏内公告为准 |
| 发热、掉帧、黑屏、排队 | 放到已知问题/热修追踪和配置页 |
| gamescom demo、review、PS5/Xbox | 放到英文 FAQ，明确 demo 不等于主机日期确认 |

## 今日移动端最容易踩的坑

- 把移动端首发当作“全平台重新开服”，忽略 PC 端 7 月 9 日以来的首月节奏。
- 首次登录先冲高画质，结果卡顿、发热或掉帧影响体验。
- 没确认账号和区服就领取关键奖励。
- 只看下载入口，不看 6 选 1、好金砖、号角和贸易场资源规则。
- 看到 gamescom demo 讨论后，把海外试玩误读成主机版日期确认。

  - https://www.taptap.cn/app/755604
- 官方海外社媒：确认参展 **gamescom 2026**，现场提供最新版本 demo 试玩；可以继续查看 demo / gameplay / review / platform 相关问题。
- 推荐相关页：平台入口、首周运营、PS5/Xbox/Review/Gameplay FAQ。
contentEn:
## Archive note

This page preserves the July 2026 PC open beta and mobile-launch context. Current Sea of Remnants routing starts from the early-2027 / December closed-beta watch, platform FAQ, and download status at /sea/version or /sea/download.

## Quick Answer

As of **July 23, 2026 at 10:00**, Sea of Remnants mobile is in its launch-day window. PC has been live since **July 9, 2026**, and mobile followed a **July 21 10:00 pre-download** window before launch. The main question is no longer whether to wait for mobile. It is how to pick the correct mobile entry, keep your account and server consistent, check device stability, and route into the right launch-month pages.

There is also a new global signal: the publisher/official channels are promoting a **gamescom 2026 playable demo**. That does not change the China mobile launch timing, but it strengthens English demand around demo, review, gameplay, PS5/Xbox, and Steam searches.

## Today’s Timeline

| Milestone | Date | Status | Next page |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PC open beta | 2026-07-09 | Live | Launch route, hotfixes, economy |
| Mobile pre-download | 2026-07-21 10:00 | Previously available | Check package integrity, storage, and final updates |
| Mobile launch | 2026-07-23 10:00 | Live today | Entry, account, specs, first-day troubleshooting |
| gamescom demo | gamescom 2026 | External exposure | Demo / gameplay / review intent |
| Page updated | 2026-07-23 | Launch-day wording | No longer a pre-launch waiting page |

## Mobile or PC Today?

| Situation | Recommendation |
| --- | --- |
| Already started on PC | Keep PC for story/resources; use mobile for dailies and light sessions |
| New today | Pick the platform you will use long-term, then keep account and server stable |
| Phone-first player | Confirm official client, account, server, and stable settings first |
| Graphics / long exploration | PC still fits long sessions and high-load combat better |
| Just researching | Read the genre FAQ, platform guide, and live-ops hub first |

## Cross-Progress Checks

1. Use the same account route across PC and mobile.
2. Keep server choice consistent.
3. Treat platform rewards, payments, reservation gifts, and compensation as official-notice dependent.

## Current Player Discussion Hotspots

| Hotspot | Site routing |
| --- | --- |
| Official iOS / Android entry | Platform entry guide |
| Whether pre-download still needs an update | First-day troubleshooting |
| PC account and server alignment | Cross-progress checks |
| Launch rewards, SSR selector, and pull count | Launch checklist, codes, and resource pages; numbers stay official-notice dependent |
| Heat, frame drops, black screens, queueing | Known issues and specs pages |
| gamescom demo, review, PS5/Xbox | English FAQ with clear platform boundaries |

## Common July 23 Mistakes

- Treating mobile launch as a full reset instead of a continuation of the July launch month.
- Pushing high graphics before stability.
- Claiming major rewards before confirming account and server.
- Reading only download pages while ignoring selector, Good Gold Bricks, Horns, and market basics.
- Reading gamescom demo discussion as a confirmed console release date.

## Read Next

1. [Platform entry guide](/en/sea/guides/platform-download-guide)
2. [Week-one live-ops hub](/en/sea/guides/week-one-live-ops-overview)
3. [First 30 minutes checklist](/en/sea/guides/launch-30min-checklist)
4. [Payment model guide](/en/sea/guides/payment-model-guide)
5. [PS5 / Xbox / Review / Gameplay FAQ](/en/sea/guides/ps5-xbox-review-gameplay-faq)

## Sources

- TapTap / channel and reservation pages: July 21, 2026 10:00 pre-download and July 23, 2026 10:00 mobile launch-day wording.
- Official/publisher gamescom 2026 demo promotion: useful for demo, gameplay, and review demand.
- Internal follow-up pages: platform entry, live-ops hub, and PS5/Xbox/review FAQ.

faq.questionZh: 今天移动端上线后，新玩家先选手机还是 PC？
faq.question: Should a new player start on mobile or PC today?
faq.answerZh: 选你长期最常用的平台更稳。如果你想长时间探索和高画质，PC 更舒服；如果你主要做日常和碎片时间，今天直接手机端入坑即可。
faq.answer: Pick the platform you will use long-term. PC is better for long exploration and higher graphics; mobile is fine for dailies and short sessions.

faq.questionZh: PC 和移动端账号要怎么统一？
faq.question: How should I keep PC and mobile progress aligned?
faq.answerZh: 先确认同一账号体系、同一区服，再领取关键奖励。平台礼包、充值和预约奖励是否完全互认，以游戏内公告为准。
faq.answer: Use the same account route and server before claiming important rewards. Platform gifts, payments, and reservation rewards should follow in-game notices.

faq.questionZh: gamescom demo 对普通玩家有什么意义？
faq.question: What does the gamescom demo mean for regular players?
faq.answerZh: 它更像海外曝光信号，会带来 demo、gameplay、review、Steam、PS5/Xbox 等搜索，不等于主机版日期已经确认。
faq.answer: It is mainly a global exposure signal that increases demo, gameplay, review, Steam, PS5/Xbox searches. It is not the same as a confirmed console release date.
